name: mac-health
description: Ask Claude how your Mac is doing: CPU, memory, disk, battery, heat and uptime, each with a clear grade.
long_description:
Mac Health gives Claude a read-only health check of your Mac:

- **diagnose_slowness** – why is my Mac slow? Likely causes ranked, each with the number behind it and what you can do.
- **get_mac_overview** – model, macOS version, uptime, CPU load, memory pressure, disk space, battery and thermal state, each graded Bra / Okej / Behöver åtgärd (Good / OK / Needs attention).
- **top_processes** – what is using CPU and memory right now, with cryptic macOS names explained.
- **memory_report** – memory pressure, swap and compression in plain language.
- **disk_report** – free space and the largest folders in your home folder (read-only).
- **battery_report** – battery health, cycles and charging tips.
- **thermal_status** – is the Mac throttling because of heat?
- **startup_items** – what starts automatically, Apple or third party.

Everything runs locally with built-in macOS tools (sysctl, sw_vers, vm_stat, memory_pressure, df, du, top, ps, pmset, ioreg). No internet access, no telemetry, no admin password, and serial numbers, UUIDs and user names are filtered out before anything reaches Claude.

tools.name: diagnose_slowness
tools.description: Why is my Mac slow? Ranked likely causes (uptime, memory, disk, busy processes, Spotlight, heat, battery) with the numbers behind them and what to do.

tools.name: get_mac_overview
tools.description: Health check of this Mac: model, macOS, uptime, CPU load, memory pressure, disk, battery and heat, each with a grade.

tools.name: top_processes
tools.description: The apps using the most CPU and memory right now, with plain-language explanations of macOS process names.

tools.name: memory_report
tools.description: Memory pressure, swap and compressed memory explained in plain language, with a grade.

tools.name: disk_report
tools.description: Free disk space with a warning when low, plus the largest folders in your home folder. Read-only, never deletes.

tools.name: battery_report
tools.description: Battery health, charge cycles, charge state and tips, with a grade. Calm answer on Macs without a battery.

tools.name: thermal_status
tools.description: Whether the Mac is slowing down because it is too hot (thermal throttling).

tools.name: startup_items
tools.description: What starts automatically (launch agents and daemons), marked Apple or third party. Lists only, never deletes.
